content.text: I call every milestone a release. By the first release I mean the creative accepts the film; by the second I mean I authorize admitting the change. Scheduling’s release frees a held shoot date. Design these concepts.
In film production, creative approval accepts the film; release authorization lets the operator admit it. In scheduling, releasing a date frees the reservation.
These meanings are separate despite the operator’s shared word.
